summary: Collects the assigned DC-operated alarm contacts at the room's supervised alarm interface.
description: Collects the assigned DC-operated alarm contacts at the room's supervised alarm interface. A room DC interface connects station battery distribution, alarm contacts and operating circuits. DC supplies may remain energized when the room's normal AC supply is unavailable, so their source and distribution boundaries must be shown separately.

In a switchroom, the station battery can continue supplying protection and breaker controls during an AC supply interruption. The alarm system should distinguish charger loss from a low battery condition. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Room alarm contacts” at the input and “Common alarm processing” at the output. Individual alarm causes must remain traceable.
